title: Venetian Masquerade Bedroom Designer
description: The user designs a luxury Venetian-themed bedroom by placing and configuring decorative venice masks on the walls while managing a fixed decoration budget. Each mask placement, resizing, or recoloring costs budget points, and the user must balance aesthetics with resource conservation while using undo/redo to refine their design.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements a Venetian masquerade bedroom interior design tool. Load minimalistic_modern_bedroom.glb as the main room environment centered at origin. Load venice_mask.glb as a decorative asset that can be cloned and placed on walls. Camera: Use OrbitControls starting inside the room at position (0, 1.6, 3) looking toward (0, 1.2, 0), constrained to stay within the room bounds. Lighting: Warm ambient light (0xffeedd, 0.4) plus two point lights simulating bedside lamps (0xffaa55) and one directional light from a window direction. Core mechanics: Display a budget counter starting at 100 points. The user has a toolbar with buttons: Place Mask (costs 10), Scale Up (costs 5), Scale Down (costs 5), Rotate 45° (costs 3), Tint Color cycle through gold/crimson/midnight-blue/ivory (costs 4), Delete (refunds 8), Undo, Redo. Clicking Place Mask enters placement mode where clicking on any wall surface raycasts and attaches a new mask clone at that point, oriented flush to the wall normal. Selecting a placed mask highlights it with an emissive outline. Scale, rotate, and tint operations apply to the selected mask. Conservation law: total budget spent minus refunds must always equal the sum of all active decoration costs. Undo/redo must track every operation including placements, deletions, transforms, and color changes, restoring budget correctly. The undo stack must hold at least 20 operations. Display a HUD showing current budget, number of masks placed, and total operations performed. When budget reaches 0, disable all cost-incurring buttons. A task completion banner appears when the user has placed at least 5 masks using at least 3 different tint colors. All interactions require 10-14 steps minimum to complete the objective.
